description.value: The Firehouse Grill is a casual full-service restaurant in downtown Nanaimo on Front Street, offering an eclectic fusion of house sushi rolls, grill items, and craft beer. The menu blends West Coast ingredients — sockeye salmon, local prawns, and albacore tuna — with Japanese technique, making it a distinctive dining stop near the Nanaimo waterfront. Cyclists finishing a coastal or inland route into Nanaimo will find a broad menu suited to refuelling.
